evidenceScope.note: Complete against this repository snapshot, not a perpetual assertion about later Admin state.

identityRoles.shopifyGid: Platform identity used for Shopify references.
identityRoles.machineFamilyKey: Stable family grouping; never proof of product identity or compatibility.
identityRoles.partIdentifier: Established technical/business part identity where evidenced.
identityRoles.sku: Commerce and inventory identity for a purchasable Shopify Variant.

additionalRhinoBusinessId.reason: No concrete F/G/J/K/L/O requirement cannot use Shopify GIDs, established model/part identifiers, and the governed commerce SKU.

skuPolicy.requirement: One current commerce SKU for each active sellable Shopify Variant after allocation approval.
skuPolicy.uniqueness: case-insensitive across active and retired identifiers
skuPolicy.caseHandling: Preserve approved display case; compare normalized uppercase values.
skuPolicy.immutability: Immutable after approval except governed correction or migration with explicit mapping and history.
skuPolicy.duplicateHandling: Block approval or migration until resolved.
skuPolicy.allocationAllowed: next unused RH-###### identifier from the governed registry allocation process only

skuSchemeDecisionPackage.variantRestructure: does not preserve SKU identity without an explicit mapping decision

barcodePolicy.reason: No demonstrated scanning, integration, GTIN, marketplace, or label consumer.
